notes: Same architecture as mainnet v4 plus multi-reserve support: ERC1967/UUPS proxies for the singletons, an UpgradeableBeacon per per-market class, the hook's permissions carried in its mined address. The factory, router, reserve, hook, guard and every beacon answer to the deployer EOA rather than a timelock: this stack exists to be torn down and rebuilt. Every reserve here shares the same underlying (6dp faucet tUSDG); approval of additional reserves is exercised on Base Sepolia with the mock sUSDai group.
fixtures: Faucet tUSDG (6dp) and tASSET (18dp) with unrestricted public mint, plus a transfer-funded simulated yield source. No mainnet assets, no real collateral. The deployer holds 1,000,000 of each; `AssetMarketTestYieldSource.simulateYield` funds yield by direct transfer.
